searchText: UTC is our friend. (How does the bot know my timezone anyway? No telling where my VPN exits.) Local system clock. The transformation is done client side. Still prefer UTC. I move. It doesn't. I recommend setting your computer time to UTC. It makes everything better. 4175 blocks left, 15.85s average: Gray Glacier should happen ~66k seconds from now, or around 10:30-11AM UTC on June 30th. Why checkpoint sync cannot be P2P? on CL? it can but is not currently supported to avoid in protocol complexity note , that you'd still need a recent checkpoint root to safely do so on the p2p. So if you already got a root out-of-band, why not just get the 30MB state too (is the thinking here) (states are much smaller and bounded for CL system state) still ~37% of nodes not updated. did we experience a very last minute update last HF as well? this is usually the case okay, ~8% of the not-updated nodes are Open Ethereum fyi so it's more like ... 29% not updated 😄
